ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the fluke body with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/light) pixels localized at distal tips and scarring points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across 85% of the fluke surface. High-contrast light mottling is mapped to the distal tips. Discrete high-intensity circular rings are visible in the lower-mid quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute pixel angle; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence at the center point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge characterized by variable pixel-amplitude peaks and sharp valleys across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer tips, following a broadly parabolic sweep ending in pointed distal vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings) present on the ventral blades; dense clusters of three-dimensional white geometric shapes (barnacles) are located on the outer distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned light-toned linear markings (rake marks) are visible across the mid-lobe surfaces, particularly on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; multiple circular 'cookie-cutter' type scars on the ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip displays an exceptionally dense, high-relief cluster of barnacles that significantly alters the smooth contour of the fluke edge.
